(SMCI) material weakness history","url":"https://ctrlworx.com/material-weakness/smci/"},{"title":"Super Micro Computer (SMCI) FY 2026 10-K Analysis (Filed 2026)","url":"https://finvincio.com/super-micro-computer-smci-2026-10k-analysis/"},{"title":"Supermicro - 10-K annual report 2026","url":"https://companiesmarketcap.com/supermicro/sec-reports-10k/0001375365-26-000022/"}]

The search turned up consistent reporting on Super Micro's FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended June 30, 2026). The SEC filing itself says management concluded internal control over financial reporting was not effective at that date. Management's conclusion rests on a single material weakness, and the filing says three weaknesses from the FY2025 report were remediated.

- **Remaining weakness:** Per one summary of the filing, the open item covers information technology controls over certain systems supporting financial reporting and the monitoring of user access to financial applications, infrastructure and programs, with operating effectiveness testing planned for fiscal 2027.
- **Remediated items:** Summaries attribute the fixes to a redesign of the enterprise resource planning security role structure and segregation of duties rulesets and the addition of qualified accounting leadership.
- **Auditor opinion:** One analysis reports that for each of fiscal 2024, fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 the auditor issued an unqualified opinion on the financial statements and an adverse opinion on internal control over financial reporting.
- **Trend:** A tracker of SEC filings lists the auditor as BDO USA and notes that the company has reported ineffective controls in multiple filings since 2021, with the 10-K for June 30, 2026 listing ITGC user access as the cause.

Sources differ on some details. One tracker dates the 10-K's filing to August 31, 2026, while other sources don't give a date. The FY2025 10-K was filed August 28, 2025. I did not independently verify the auditor opinion or the filing date against the EDGAR document, so the primary source is the SEC 10-K itself, which is the best place to confirm the exact wording of the auditor's attestation report.

Search results cover the FY2026 10-K and the August 2026 earnings release, but I found no direct inventory balance from the filing itself.

- **10-K:** An SEC-hosted Form 10-K for FY2026 exists. Its gross-margin table shows cost of sales of $34,835.8 million, gross profit of $4,227.3 million, and a gross margin of 10.8%, down from 11.1%. The company attributed the decline primarily to competitive pricing to gain market share, product and customer mix, and higher manufacturing-related expenses. Tariff expenses rose sharply, and vendor rebates fell.
- **Revenue:** Net sales for the full fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, were $39.1 billion versus $22.0 billion for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2025.
- **Earnings release:** The release is dated August 11, 2026. It reports net income for fiscal year 2026 of $2.2 billion, or $3.26 per diluted share. A separate non-GAAP gross margin for the full year was 10.9%. The release describes the figures as preliminary, because financial closing procedures were not yet complete, so the 10-K figures may differ.
- **Q4 margin:** Results differ by source. One reports a gross margin of 17.5% versus 9.9% in Q3'26 and 9.5% in Q4'25. The company's own non-GAAP figure is 17.6%.
- **Inventory:** A third-party analysis states the cash conversion cycle widened to 113 days from 99 days, driven by inventory days of 92 and payable days of 18. This is secondary data, so verify it against the 10-K balance sheet.
- **Outlook:** The company expects net sales in the range of $65.0 billion to $72.0 billion for fiscal year 2027.

content.text:
# Super Micro（SMCI）FY2026 10-K 重大誤述風險評估：**約 70／100（偏高）**

我只讀了搜尋摘要和第三方整理，沒有逐頁讀 10-K 原文。有些數字（見下方「待查證」）互相矛盾，請當作初步評估。

## 推高風險的因素

1. **內部控制仍有重大缺失（最重要）**
   - 管理層認定截至 2026/6/30 的財報內控無效，仍有一項重大缺失，內容是財報相關系統的 IT 一般控制，特別是使用者存取權限的監控。
   - 摘要稱 BDO 對 FY2024、FY2025、FY2026 都對財報出具無保留意見，但對內控出具否定意見。
   - 這家公司自 2021 年起多次回報內控無效。
   - 存取權限管理失效，代表帳務資料被不當更動的風險沒有被有效擋住。
   - 好的一面是，FY2025 的另外三項缺失據稱已改善（ERP 角色與職務分工重整、補強會計主管）。
   - 但剩下的缺失要到 FY2027 才會測試營運有效性。

2. **歷史紀錄**
   - 2024 年 Hindenburg 指控、前任會計師 EY 辭任、延遲申報 10-K，都與會計與治理有關。
   - 這類公司過去出過問題，再出問題的機率比一般公司高。

3. **成長過快，製造壓力大**
   - 營收從 FY2025 約 220 億美元，成長到 FY2026 約 391 億美元，成長約 78%。
   - 規模這麼大的成長，加上交易量與人員快速擴張，通常會增加收入認列截止點（cut-off）、存貨計價與成本分攤出錯的機率。

4. **容易出錯的高風險會計科目**
   - **存貨**：據第三方資料，存貨天數約 92 天，現金轉換週期由 99 天拉長到 113 天，營運資金吃緊。AI 伺服器 GPU 價格波動大，有跌價與呆滯風險。
   - **收入認列**：大型客戶訂單、捆綁安裝或交付條件，以及客戶集中度。
   - **供應商回扣與關稅費用**：兩者變動很大（回扣減少、關稅費用增加），都需要管理層估計。
   - **毛利率**：全年毛利率 10.8%，單季卻有差異極大的說法（見下）。

## 降低風險的因素

- 簽證會計師是 BDO，對財報本身出具**無保留意見**，代表審計上沒有發現必須保留的誤述。
- 三項先前缺失已被認定改善。
- 公司已揭露缺失並提出改善計畫，比隱瞞的情況好。

## 待查證（會改變分數）

- **Q4 毛利率**：搜尋結果有的說 17.5%，對比 Q3 的 9.9%、去年同期的 9.5%。單季飆升近 8 個百分點對這家公司很反常，我沒查證是否為真，也不知道是否來自一次性項目。如果是真的，需要查是否有存貨或回扣的估計調整，這是重點。
- **財報日期**：第三方稱 10-K 在 8/31 提交，法說會在 8/11 公布的是「初步」數字，要核對 10-K 與新聞稿之間有沒有調整。
- **審計報告原文**：關鍵審計事項（CAM）和 BDO 的內控否定意見措辭，我沒讀原文。
- **存貨餘額、應收帳款與客戶集中度**：我沒有直接取得 10-K 的資產負債表數字。

## 結論

分數約 70：財報被重大誤述的可能性明顯高於一般大型科技股，主因是內控無效、歷史紀錄、高速成長，再加上存貨和收入認列這幾個高風險科目。這不等於財報已經有誤，BDO 的財報意見是無保留的。我會把它當成「需要額外懷疑與壓低估值確信度」的公司，而不是「已確認造假」。

如果你要，我可以進一步讀 10-K 原文，核對 Q4 毛利率、存貨、應收帳款與審計報告的 CAM，把分數縮到更窄的區間。

Sources:
- [Super Micro Computer, Inc. – Form 10-K FY2026（SEC）](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm)
- [Financial analysis of Super Micro Computer, fiscal 2026（sec-api.io）](https://sec-api.io/insights/financial-analysis-of-super-micro-computer-fiscal-2026)
- [Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Reports Remediation Progress, With IT Control Weakness Remaining（Yahoo Finance）](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/super-micro-computer-smci-flags-091139487.html)
- [Super Micro Computer (SMCI) material weakness history（ctrlworx）](https://ctrlworx.com/material-weakness/smci/)
- [Super Micro's working capital is under pressure（Deep Quarry）](https://deepquarry.substack.com/p/super-micros-working-capital-is-under)
- [Supermicro Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results](https://www.supermicro.com/en/pressreleases/supermicro-announces-fourth-quarter-and-full-fiscal-year-2026-financial-results)
